title: Structure Fix
body:
**StructureFix is a datapack that fixes bilding mistakes made in minecrafts vanilla structures, without altering their purpose or design.**

Some fixes include missing blocks at the Top of the Pillager outposts, incorrectly placed Tuff- and Copperblocks in the Trial chambers and random holes in some structures like Woodland mansions or End ships.

![Pillager outpost before and after the Fix](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/575124d8bd91b63c4eba6c90a4a792e43e66dcc9.png)

![Trial chambers before the Fix](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Lz1vNaxV/images/ed0369bba6901c09b4758b4c0f30626610742dcd_350.webp) 
![Trial chambers after the Fix](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/Lz1vNaxV/images/b7e821c0c30dfcaafd5c80e8ea444d7b8855fd6f_350.webp)
